messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Symmetry-restricted ansatz decomposing the square into congruent subregions with one point each

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Partition the unit square into 13 congruent right isosceles triangles via a recursive subdivision (a 4x4 grid with two cells merged), placing one point at the incenter of each subtriangle. This symmetry-restricted configuration achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/64, arising from the closest triple of incenter points in adjacent subtriangles, and no other congruent-subdivision ansatz with 13 points yields a larger minimum."}
